 Union Parish wanted suspect believed to be in Florida 
 By Charles Quigley Published : Oct. 28, 2026 at 12:07 PM CDT | Updated : 2 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google UNION PARISH, La. (KNOE) - The Union Parish Sheriff’s Office is currently looking for a man they believe is in Lake Worth, Florida, but has ties to Farmerville.
 UPSO is searching for Jason Allan Macre (UPSO) Jason Allan Macre, 36, is wanted on charges of illegal transmission of monetary funds, bank fraud, computer fraud and felony theft. 
 Deputies said Macre is 6 feet 2 inches tall and weighs 185 pounds.
 If you have any information about his whereabouts, contact UPSO at 318-368-3124.
